subject.title: [Bug]: Notarized macOS app auto-terminates ~0.5s after launch (no menu-bar icon) in remote mode — macOS 26

question: Should maintainers run a latest notarized macOS 26 remote-mode launch proof before any fix PR is queued for this issue?
rationale: Source inspection shows the implicated path still exists, but the failure depends on notarized macOS app lifecycle/signing behavior that this read-only Linux review cannot reproduce safely.

options.title: Run packaged macOS proof
options.body: Use an official notarized latest build on macOS 26 in remote mode, capture logs/process residency/menu-bar state, and scope a fix only after the trigger is confirmed.

options.title: Ask for latest-release reporter proof
options.body: Keep the issue waiting on reporter evidence from v2026.6.11 or newer if maintainers cannot access the required macOS 26 setup now.

options.title: Close as obsolete
options.body: Close only if maintainers have independent latest-release notarized proof that the app now stays resident in the same remote-mode setup.

recommendation.title: Run packaged macOS proof
recommendation.body: Use an official notarized latest build on macOS 26 in remote mode, capture logs/process residency/menu-bar state, and scope a fix only after the trigger is confirmed.
